args.approval: a valid advance approval accompanies the lock
args.evidence: absent: none (Solana None, Ethereum zeros). opens: the notice opening. mismatch: any other pair
args.open_ok: true: expected_open is the swap's open hash. false: any other 32 bytes
args.payout: take only. taker: the taker's own address. other: another valid address. invalid: Solana, the default key, the program id or a token account; Ethereum, the zero address. lock ignores it (always `taker` in these vectors)

callers.payout: the payout address named at take, when it is not the taker's own

how_to_replay.closed: the row is marked closed in SPEC 3.4/3.5 and nothing was parked: Solana closes the swap account in the same instruction (the state then reads as 0); Ethereum keeps the swap in DONE.
how_to_replay.env: which payout destinations can receive (pay or park), the maker's open_pending before a lock or take, `maker_paused` (the pause that applies to this open), and `caps`: the switch, max_swap and max_open of the swap's asset and its open_value before the call (decimal strings). Rows start from open_value 0 except the lock/take rows whose env says otherwise (as with open_pending, the replay presets it). On Ethereum the treasury share only increments treasuryAccrued: it is listed as paid to `treasury`. On Solana `treasury_can_receive: false` at split_deposit is also how the `treasury` slot of the other split_mode is expressed: the treasury's half is parked.
how_to_replay.error: the chain's error name. A call refused only because of the time is TooLate if one of its windows in that state has already closed, else TooEarly. Check order: direction, caller, state and open hash, time, then secret or evidence.
how_to_replay.hostile_after_open: true in the invariant3/ sequences: right after the open the replay sets every cap to zero with the switch on, sets both pause bits (Solana) or paused (Ethereum) and bumps both epochs; every later step must still match
how_to_replay.multi_sequence: As a sequence, over several swaps of one asset and one maker: every step names its swap by index in `swap`; the swaps have different takers. `final.swaps[i]` is null for a swap that never opened.
how_to_replay.open_value_after: the asset's open value after the call: plus the counted value (amount in A, amount + deposit in B) at lock/take, minus it at the one transition that enters HOLD or DONE, otherwise unchanged
how_to_replay.payouts: `parked: false` was transferred; `parked: true` stayed in escrow and was added to owed_*. A payout of zero is absent.
how_to_replay.row: Start from no swap. Run `open` (lock or take) by the taker wallet at `open.at`, then each `setup` step at its `at`, check the swap equals `from`, then run `step` at `step.at` and compare with `step.expect`.
how_to_replay.sequence: Start the maker record at `initial_maker`. Run every step at its `at`. A step with `expect.ok == false` must fail with `expect.error` and change nothing.
how_to_replay.swap_fields: `payout`: none (direction A, zeros on chain), taker (the taker's own address), other. `watcher`: a watcher is named. `flags` bit 5 (32): counted in the open value. On a direction-B swap that ended in a claim with `payout` = other, `owed_taker` is owed to the payout address (Ethereum: owed[token][payout])
